name: steam-mcp
description: Read-only Steam: games, reviews, current builds/depots, prices, players, libraries, friends, and achievements.
long_description:
A read-only Model Context Protocol server for Valve's public Steam APIs plus a disclosed, keyless community mirror of current public SteamCMD AppInfo. Ask about store details, official review scores and large review corpora, current players, prices, tags, patches, and current build/branch/depot/manifest metadata, as well as public account data such as libraries, friends, playtime, and achievements. The MCP never scrapes SteamDB and stores nothing persistently; technical AppInfo results are current snapshots, not history.

A free Steam Web API key is optional and is only needed for account-specific tools and personalization. The server never sends messages, changes status, launches games, trades, or makes purchases. Friends lists, owned games, and achievements are visible only when the target Steam profile's relevant privacy setting is Public.

steam_api_key.title: Steam Web API Key (optional)
steam_api_key.description: Optional. 22 of the 44 tools — store, reviews, prices, current players, current AppInfo/builds/depots, deals, Steam Deck, and achievement rarity — work with no key at all. A key (32 hex characters, free at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey) unlocks 19 account-only tools plus personalization: library, playtime, friends, achievements, wishlist, inventory, and taste matching.

steam_user.title: Your Steam name (optional)
steam_user.description: Your own Steam vanity name, SteamID64, or profile URL. When set, tools like 'analyze my library' or 'my wishlist' default to you, so you don't have to give your ID each time.
